about_the_game:
Nightfall Secrets is a 4 vs 1 cooperative horror game that blends tension, strategy, and a gripping atmosphere. Four players must work together to complete a series of random objectives and escape before they fall victim to a supernatural, AI-controlled entity.

  • Play with a Team: Play solo or with up to 4 players in co-op mode, working together to complete all missions and survive.

  • Listening AI: The enemy is AI-controlled with varying abilities, and it can hear player footsteps, dropped items, or communication sounds—every noise can spell doom.

  • Diverse AI Types: Each AI has a unique playstyle and abilities, from fast hunters to silent stalkers who manipulate the atmosphere.

  • Random Objectives: In every match, the objectives will change randomly, creating a fresh and challenging experience each time you play.

  • Chilling Environments: Explore dark and secret-filled places, from underground bunkers to abandoned buildings steeped in horror.

  • Escape or Become a Victim: Complete all objectives to open the escape route—but the clock is ticking, and the AI will not stop its hunt.

  • A Different Experience Every Time: With AI variations, changing layouts, and randomized objectives, no two games will ever feel the same.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains horror elements involving the investigation of mysterious cases and supernatural disturbances. In some scenarios, players may encounter dead bodies or unsettling paranormal events designed to create a tense and eerie atmosphere.

There is no depiction of sexual acts, sexual violence, drug or alcohol use, or self-harm. The focus is on investigation and psychological horror without gratuitous or overly graphic content.

This game may not be suitable for players sensitive to themes of death or intense horror.

  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or Intel i5-9400F
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

short_description: Nightfall Secrets is a 4v1 co-op horror game where up to 4 players must complete randomized objectives and escape—while being hunted by an AI-controlled supernatural entity that reacts to sound. Every match is a tense battle of strategy, stealth, and survival.
